validation_policy.local: Static checks plus the task's exact tests command only; broad local suites refuse by default.
progression: one frozen-SHA authoritative GitHub Actions matrix
validation_policy.reuse: Cite unchanged green only when source, tests, settings, inventory, selectors, radius, shard plan, runner, browser executable/version/flags, fixture server, artifacts, and environment fingerprints are equal.
validation_policy.invalidation: Any governed source/test/settings/inventory/selector/fixture/generator/checksum/manifest/ledger/shard-plan/browser-environment byte change invalidates only affected evidence; never rerun unchanged green.
validation_policy.correction: Classify every direct failure once with reason, owner, and cluster before correction; one red matrix creates one inventory/correction wave; third Plan return is the bounded PLAN-STABILIZATION successor.

selector/browser/cleanup policy precedes the sole workflow/local-runner owner
sealed terminal CI, dashboard publication, and cleanup receipts precede non-cumulative metrics
exact frozen-SHA CI and protected-main green precede any later human-authorized version/tag/release
